tables.name: abac_policy_definitions
tables.comment: Lists ABAC policies with their full authoring metadata.

columns.name: policy_id
columns.comment: Unique identifier of the policy.

columns.name: policy_name
columns.comment: Name of the policy.

columns.name: policy_type
columns.comment: The policy type. For example, ROW_FILTER, COLUMN_MASK, GRANT, or DENY.

columns.name: catalog_name
columns.comment: Name of the catalog the policy is attached to (or that contains the schema/table the policy is attached to).

columns.name: schema_name
columns.comment: Name of the schema the policy is attached to (or that contains the table the policy is attached to). NULL for CATALOG-attached policies.

columns.name: securable_name
columns.comment: Name of the securable the policy is attached to. NULL for CATALOG-attached and SCHEMA-attached policies.

columns.name: on_securable_type
columns.comment: Type of the securable the policy is attached to. For example, CATALOG, SCHEMA, or TABLE.

columns.name: to_principals
columns.comment: List of principals (users, groups, service principals) the policy applies to.

columns.name: except_principals
columns.comment: List of principals excluded from the policy.

columns.name: for_securable_type
columns.comment: Type of securable the policy targets when evaluated.

columns.name: privileges
columns.comment: Privileges granted or denied by the policy. NULL for ROW_FILTER and COLUMN_MASK policies.

columns.name: when_condition
columns.comment: Conditional expression under which the policy applies. NULL when no WHEN clause is set.

columns.name: match_columns
columns.comment: Columns referenced by the policy. NULL for GRANT and DENY policies.

columns.name: created_by
columns.comment: Principal who created the policy.
